extracted.name: Lisa’s Banana Butter Frosting
extracted.description: Full of fruity flavor, Lisa’s banana butter frosting recipe with mashed bananas, butter, and confectioners’ sugar is perfect on peanut butter cupcakes.
instruction_lines: Beat mashed banana, lemon juice, and salt together in a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds. Beat in softened butter until creamy, about 1 minute. Slowly beat in confectioners’ sugar, 1 cup at a time, until smooth.
